answer: Locks are logged in dawn, expire in timber, and sable lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 28 aliases hence needs 78 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2292 identities would post 2303 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
